sound_cache_close.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 7: CE sound-cache datum
sound_cache_close.reason: scenario_tags_unload drains the sound datum and calls data_make_invalid before tag teardown. The generated empty body left map-owned cache state unretired.

sound_cache_delete.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 7: CE sound-cache datum
sound_cache_delete.reason: sound_dispose always calls sound_cache_delete after the uninitialized manager path. CE disposes the datum and clears the physical base.

sound_cache_flush.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 7: CE sound-cache datum
sound_cache_flush.reason: HaloScript sound_cache_flush_evaluate deletes only entries whose software and hardware counts are both zero.

sound_cache_idle.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 7: CE sound-cache datum
sound_cache_idle.reason: sound_idle and sound_render call sound_cache_idle after the platform-disabled manager path. An empty datum has no LRU pages to advance.

sound_cache_new.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 7: CE sound-cache datum
sound_cache_new.reason: sound_initialize calls sound_cache_new before the HALO_PS2 platform -1 return. CE creates the 512-entry xbox sound datum and binds physical_memory_get_sound_cache_base_address().

sound_cache_open.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 7: CE sound-cache datum
sound_cache_open.reason: scenario_tags_load pairs sound_cache_open with close. CE calls data_make_valid on the sound datum.

sound_cache_sound_finished.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 7: CE sound-cache datum
sound_cache_sound_finished.reason: channel stop/queue paths call this. CE returns immediately when sound_cache_sound_get_cache_sound is NULL, otherwise decrements software_reference_count.

strtok.reason: csstrtok returns strtok(s1, s2). cseries.h remaps the strtok name onto csstrtok. The rooted member is libc_a-strtok.o; EE is single-threaded so the reent save pointer is that contract.

structure_bsp_header_deregister_vertex_b.reason: scenario_structure_bsp_unload calls this. CE only BlockUntilNotBusy on D3D buffers from excluded cache_files_windows.c. No D3D registration is created on this profile.

structure_bsp_header_register_vertex_buf.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 7: no D3D vertex-buffer registrar
structure_bsp_header_register_vertex_buf.reason: scenario_structure_bsp_load calls this. CE writes D3DCOMMON_TYPE_VERTEXBUFFER and IDirect3DVertexBuffer8_Register. Those D3D objects are not consumed by the PS2 cache/GS path.

tags_header_deregister_vertex_and_index_.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 7: no D3D vertex-buffer registrar
tags_header_deregister_vertex_and_index_.reason: scenario_tags_unload calls this after cache_file_close. CE waits on D3D vertex/index buffers that this profile never registers.

tags_header_register_vertex_and_index_bu.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 7: no D3D vertex-buffer registrar
tags_header_register_vertex_and_index_bu.reason: scenario_tags_load calls this for the tag header. CE Register/Common writes are Xbox D3D-only.

texture_cache_close.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 7: no texture_cache_new datum
texture_cache_close.reason: scenario_tags_unload calls texture_cache_close. CE flushes then data_make_invalid. texture_cache_new is not a live external, so there is no textures datum to invalidate.

texture_cache_debug_options.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 7: CE texture-cache debug bytes
texture_cache_debug_options.reason: The defining objects are texture_cache_graph_definition and texture_cache_list_definition, which alias texture_cache_debug_options and texture_cache_debug_options + 0x1. CE initializes {0}. The Xbox debug renderer that reads graph/list is excluded.

texture_cache_flush.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 7: no texture_cache_new datum
texture_cache_flush.reason: HaloScript texture_cache_flush_evaluate kicks D3D and lruv_flush. No texture_cache_new datum and no D3D device exist in this closure.

texture_cache_open.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 7: no texture_cache_new datum
texture_cache_open.reason: scenario_tags_load calls texture_cache_open before sound_cache_open. CE data_make_valid requires the textures datum created by texture_cache_new, which is not a live external.

time.owner: Pinned PS2SDK libcglue RTC / Newlib time
time.reason: GetSystemTime, system_seconds, and write_to_error_file call time() for wall-clock diagnostics. The rooted member is libc_a-time.o. This is not GetTickCount/EE bus-clock frame timing.

towlower.owner: HCU PS2 M0 batch 7: ASCII identifier fold

transport_initialize.reason: game_initialize calls transport_initialize. CE returns _transport_error_none only after XNet/WSA startup. The generated zero reports success for a service that did not start.
